name: YuE 2
notes: Style prompts are comma-separated descriptor lists: genre first, then tempo, instruments, mood and production. Vocals are a SEPARATE list and deliberately so — the voice is the one thing a person changes independently of the genre, and a genre prompt that already said 'female vocal' fought with a male voice picked next to it. Each style names the vocal it was written around ('vocal'), and that one is offered first. Section tags below are the ones YuE reads out of the lyrics to know where a part starts.
